class.name: OcgGraphic3dGraphicdriver
class.brief_description: This class allows the definition of a graphic driver for 3d interface (currently only OpenGl driver is used).
class.description: ! This class allows the definition of a graphic driver ! for 3d interface (currently only OpenGl driver is used).

method.name: InquireLightLimit
method.description: Request maximum number of active light sources supported by driver and hardware.

method.name: InquirePlaneLimit
method.description: Request maximum number of active clipping planes supported by driver and hardware.

method.name: InquireViewLimit
method.description: Request maximum number of views supported by driver.

method.name: ZLayers
method.description: Returns list of Z layers defined for the graphical driver.

method.name: ZLayerSettings
method.description: Returns the settings of a single Z layer.

method.name: NewIdentification
method.description: Returns a new identification number for a new structure.

method.name: RemoveIdentification
method.description: Frees the identifier of a structure.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
